Road trips used to be stressful, until GPS linked cruise control set the pace. Simply set the desired speed and the system uses GPS navigation data to maintain that speed without driver intervention - including slowing down for curves and anticipating hills. This can help minimize driver fatigue and improve overall fuel economy. Meet your ultimate co-pilot; GPS linked cruise control.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Forward collision mitigation - Forward thinking. You look away for just a second and suddenly the vehicle in front of you has stopped. That's when the forward collision mitigation system comes to life.  When it senses an impending impact, it will activate a combination of features to help prevent or reduce the severity of an accident.  Forward collision mitigation is always looking ahead. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Rear camera - Watching your back!  The rear camera helps you see obstacles and hazards you otherwise couldn't by showing enhanced images of what is behind you. description: * THIS VEHICLE COMES WITH HONDA OF PORT RICHEY'S LIFETIME POWERTRAIN WARRANTY * The 2025 Honda Civic Sport in Urban Grey Pearl is a compact car that offers a perfect balance of sporty design, everyday comfort, and modern style. One of the most noticeable features of this car is its Urban Grey Pearl exterior color. This shade of gray is not plain or dull it has a soft metallic and pearl finish that gives it depth and a slightly reflective shine. In bright light, it can look lighter and almost silvery, while in darker conditions it appears deeper and more refined. This gives the car a clean, sophisticated look while still feeling sporty and modern.  The exterior design of the 2025 Civic Sport is sleek and well-proportioned. It has a low and wide stance that makes it look stable and athletic. The front end features a simple but bold grille, along with slim LED headlights that give the car a sharp and focused expression. Along the sides, smooth lines flow from front to back, creating an aerodynamic shape that looks both stylish and efficient. The Sport trim adds black accents, including black alloy wheels and dark trim pieces, which contrast nicely with the Urban Grey Pearl paint. This combination gives the car a subtle but aggressive look that stands out without being too flashy.  Under the hood, the Civic Sport is powered by a 2.0-liter 4-cylinder engine that provides smooth and reliable performance. It delivers enough power for daily driving, including commuting, highway travel, and running errands. The engine is paired with a continuously variable transmission, which helps create a smooth driving experience and good fuel efficiency. The car handles well, with responsive steering and a stable ride, making it easy to drive in both city and highway conditions.  Inside, the cabin of the 2025 Civic Sport is clean, modern, and comfortable. The dashboard has a simple layout with a unique design that runs across the front, giving it a slightly upscale feel. The seats are supportive and comfortable, usually finished in black cloth that matches the sporty theme of the car. There is enough room for passengers in both the front and back seats, making it practical for everyday use. The trunk also provides a good amount of space for groceries, luggage, or other items.  The technology in the Civic Sport is designed to be easy to use and convenient. It includes a touchscreen infotainment system that allows you to connect your smartphone for music, navigation, and calls. Controls are placed within easy reach, and features like steering wheel buttons and a digital display help make driving more comfortable and less distracting.  Safety is another strong point of this car. It comes with a range of built-in safety features that help protect you and your passengers. These systems can assist with staying in your lane, adjusting your speed with traffic, and helping prevent collisions. They work quietly in the background to make driving safer and more confident.  Overall, the 2025 Honda Civic Sport in Urban Grey Pearl is a well-rounded car that combines style, reliability, and practicality. The Urban Grey Pearl color adds a refined and modern touch, making the car look more premium while still keeping a sporty edge. description: Why BUY from Jacobs Motors?     When you choose this Serenity White 2026 Hyundai Sonata SEL Sport with 5,506 miles, you are not just buying a used vehicle - you are investing in quality, reliability and peace of mind. Our clientele depend on us for Transparent Pricing, Convenience and, most importantly, Customer FIRST Service!     No Accidents!      One Owner!  What this vehicle includes:     Option Group 01          Convenience Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go. Set it and forget it.  Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety.  Now, with Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and the vehicle ahead.  It's stop/go feature automatically brings the vehicle to a stop if traffic stops and resumes distance pacing cruise when traffic starts to move again.  Adaptive cruise control with traffic stop-go; your ultimate co-pilot.Safety and Security Hands-on cruise control. Set it and forget it. Road trips used to be stressful. Cruise control only managed speed, but not distance or safety. Now, with hands-on cruise control, simply set your desired speed and let sensor technology maintain a safe distance between you and surrounding vehicles. It slows you down; speeds you up and even keeps you in your own lane. Meet your ultimate co-pilot with hands-on cruise control. Pedestrian impact prevention - An extra step toward safety.  Pedestrians don't always stop, look, and listen, but with Pedestrian Impact Prevention, your vehicle is equipped to better see them and avoid them. This system constantly monitors the road ahead to identify and track pedestrians. It projects that image to an interior display screen, AND should an impact become likely, Pedestrian impact prevention takes steps to avoid a collision. Brake assist - Stop right there.
